diagnostics.message: `:resource.google_project_iam_member.additive` accepts arbitrary role names from `var.iam_additive_roles`, which may include a custom role created by `:resource.google_project_iam_custom_role.roles`. Without ordering, Terraform may attempt to grant the role before it exists; add an explicit dependency when additive bindings can use these custom roles.

`:resource.google_project_iam_member.additive` can grant roles supplied through `var.iam_additive_roles`, including project custom roles created by `:resource.google_project_iam_custom_role.roles`. Unlike the authoritative IAM binding, it has no ordering dependency on those role creations, so Terraform may attempt the grant before a custom role exists.
